steps.text: Materials Needed: Colored tiles, three each of five different colors.\n\nOverview: Working with nonsense words that have three sounds (CVC). Consonant-Vowel-Consonant. Use ONLY short vowel sounds.
Now you're going to break apart slightly longer words. Ready? The first word is KOV.
Expected: KOV
Now say it very slowly.
Expected: /k/-/oooo/-/v/
How many sounds did you hear in that word?
Expected: 3
Good listening. So pull down the tiles.
Now touch-and-say each sound.
Student touches the first tile and says /k/, touches the second tile and says /o/, then touches the third tile and says /v/.
That's all I want you to do, so wash the sound off those tiles.
Dictate the remaining words one by one: BIP, VASH, SHOSH, THAJ, RIN, ZOF. Use Extra Practice words if student struggles.
This time, after you break a word I'll change a sound. Then we'll do a new step. Ready? The first word is FIM.
Expected: FIM
Say it again ... very slowly.
Expected: /f/-/iiii/-/m/
Pull down the tiles.
Touch-and-say.
Student touches first tile and says /f/, touches second tile and says /i/, touches third tile and says /m/.
Now watch carefully. I'm going to change this sound to /a/.
To figure out the new word, touch-and-say those sounds.
Student touches first tile and says /f/, touches second tile and says /a/, touches third tile and says /m/.
Slowly blend them into a word.
Expected: /f/-/aaaa/-/m/
Now say it fast like a word.
Expected: FAM
Here's the new step. Watch carefully. I'm going to remove this tile.
Touch-and-say the sounds - just those sounds.
Student touches first tile and says /f/, touches second tile and says /a/.
Slowly blend.
Expected: /f/-/aaaa/
Fast like a word.
Expected: FA
Great. Go ahead and wash off those tiles.
Dictate the remaining sets: THAP -> THIP -> THI, LOM -> DOM -> DO, DAV -> DAP -> AP, MISH -> MOSH -> OSH.
Now we're going to compare two words. The first word is THOP.
Expected: THOP
Say it slowly.
Expected: /th/-/oooo/-/p/
Touch-and-say using the first row.
Student touches first tile and says /th/, touches second tile and says /o/, touches third tile and says /p/.
Good. The second word is THOK.
Expected: THOK
Slowly.
Expected: /th/-/oooo/-/k/
Touch-and-say using the second row.
Student touches first tile and says /th/, touches second tile and says /o/, touches third tile and says /k/.
Here's the tough part. Touch-and-say until you know whether these two are different, these two are different, or these two are different. THOP. THOK.
Expected: The last sounds are different.
Perfect. Now go ahead and wash off those tiles.
Dictate the remaining sets: LIB & LOB, PIV & DIV, NIM & NISH, KOV & TOV, RAJ & RAB.
